name: DAO Maker vesting unprotected init()
summary: The vesting implementation's init() had no caller authentication or one-time initialization guard, so calling it again made the attacker the proxy's owner. The attacker then used the owner-only emergencyExit() path to sweep the proxy's vested sale tokens.
notes: The EIP-1167 proxy deployment fixed the implementation address in its runtime. The proxy runtime and implementation runtime remained unchanged through the exploit.
SlowMist reports nearly $4 million taken across the DeRace, Coinspaid, Capsule Coin, and Showcase vesting proxies. The reported figure is treated as the gross campaign loss.
The loss uses SlowMist's campaign estimate rather than a separately repriced ledger of all four volatile sale tokens.
